feedback: The camera keeps getting stuck behind walls in tight corridors.
Camera clips through walls when I fight near the edge of the arena.
I lost track of enemies because the camera swings around too fast during lock-on.
Camera is way too close to the character, I can't see attacks coming from behind.
The camera fights me whenever I try to dodge near a wall.
Lock-on camera flips to the wrong enemy constantly.
Please add a camera distance slider, the default view feels cramped.
Camera gets stuck behind pillars in the courtyard fight.
Got motion sick from how jerky the camera is when sprinting.
Camera auto-centering is too aggressive, it keeps snapping back.
In the cave section the camera clipped into the rock and I couldn't see anything.
The camera is the biggest problem right now, it ruins the combat.
The Warden boss at the end of level 3 is a massive difficulty spike.
Went from breezing through level 2 to dying 15 times on the Warden.
Difficulty jumps way too hard in level 3, almost quit.
The Warden boss does too much damage compared to everything before it.
Level 3 difficulty spike feels unfair, no checkpoint before the boss either.
I had no idea how to beat the Warden, the difficulty curve is a wall.
Enemies in level 3 suddenly hit twice as hard, felt like a different game.
Rage quit at the Warden. Way harder than anything else in the build.
The arena wave before the Warden is brutal and then the boss is even harder.
Difficulty spike at level 3 needs smoothing, maybe add a checkpoint.
I didn't know where to go after the bridge collapsed.
The objective in the market district is unclear, I wandered for 10 minutes.
No waypoint after talking to the blacksmith, had no clue what to do next.
Objective text says 'find the key' but doesn't say where to look.
Got lost after the bridge cutscene, the objective marker disappeared.
I wasn't sure what the goal was in level 2, the quest log was vague.
Needed a hint about where to go next, the objective was confusing.
Spent ages looking for the exit in the market district, objective unclear.
Objective marker doesn't update after picking up the key.
Game crashed to desktop on level 2 right after the bridge cutscene.
Crash on level 2 when entering the sewers.
Level 2 crashed twice for me, both times during the bridge collapse.
Hard crash in level 2, lost about 20 minutes of progress.
The game froze then crashed on level 2 loading screen.
Crashed on level 2 after opening the inventory during the cutscene.
Level 2 crash again, same spot near the bridge.
Crash to desktop on level 2, no error message.
Combat feels really satisfying, the parry timing is great.
Love the art style, the lighting in the forest is gorgeous.
The soundtrack during boss fights is amazing.
Dodge roll has too many invincibility frames, feels too forgiving.
Controls feel floaty when jumping between platforms.
I'd like to remap the dodge button, it's awkward on controller.
The menu font is too small to read on a TV.
Inventory UI is cluttered and hard to navigate.
Framerate drops in the market district when lots of NPCs are around.
Some textures pop in late when sprinting through the forest.
The story hook is interesting but the dialogue is a bit long.
I want to know more about the main character's backstory.
Tutorial explains combo attacks too quickly, I forgot them right away.
The opening tutorial is too long before you get to real combat.
Health potions are too rare, I never had enough.
Upgrading weapons feels rewarding, more of that please.
Footstep sounds are too loud compared to music.
Enemy variety is good in level 1 but repetitive later.
Sprinting drains stamina way too fast.
Subtitles go by too fast during cutscenes.
Overall really fun, would play the full game.
